document.title: Throne of Grace Integrated Ventures — Customer Web Page Overview
document.purpose: A complete, shareable description of the customer-facing web app: what it is, how it works, what it contains, and how people use it.
document.generatedFor: Sharing with someone to understand the customer page in full
document.scope: Customer web app (apps/web) as implemented in the current codebase
document.note: This reflects the current operating plan: customers place refill orders and the team refills the cylinder on-site (at the customer's location) or at the station. No cylinder is dispatched to the customer.

product.name: Throne of Grace Integrated Ventures — LPG Customer Service
product.audience: LPG customers (guests and signed-in account holders)
product.goal: Let customers request a cylinder refill, track progress, and manage their refill requests in one place, with clear status and payment information.

serviceModel.summary: Refill-order focused. The business receives a refill order, then refills the customer's cylinder either on-site at the customer's location or when the customer brings it to the station.

options.label: On-site refill (we come to you)
options.description: The team comes to the customer's location and fills the cylinder there.
options.dispatchNote: No cylinder is dispatched to the customer.

options.label: Station refill (bring it to us)
options.description: The customer brings the cylinder to the station for refilling.

serviceModel.paymentPolicy: Payment is confirmed before a refill is marked complete. Customers can see payment status (unpaid, pending confirmation, paid, waived) and method/amount when recorded.
serviceModel.statusNote: For an on-site refill, the 'Dispatched' stage is presented to the customer as the team being en route to their location.

technology.uiLibrary: Shared internal UI components (@togi/ui): Button, Card, TextInput, TextArea, Select, StatusPill, Modal, Skeleton, EmptyState, ErrorState, Toasts
technology.sharedDomain: @togi/shared (types and transition rules consumed from source)

devServer.apiProxy: Same-origin /api proxied to the API at http://localhost:3000

technology.buildOutput: Static production build (Vite), with lazy-loaded route pages
technology.accessibilityAndMotion: Skip-to-content link, labeled form fields, focus/keyboard-friendly controls, and reduced-motion-safe behavior (global motion guards and reveal fallbacks).

authenticationAndAccess.method: Phone-based one-time passcode (OTP), no password for customers
authenticationAndAccess.audience: Customer audience (separate from admin/staff). Audience-bound session cookies; staff sessions are not accepted on customer routes.

clientSecurity.csrf: Double-submit CSRF: readable CSRF cookie echoed as x-csrf-token on mutations; client can refresh via /auth/csrf and replay on CSRF expiry

modes.title: Sign in
modes.copy: Text a code to the phone number. No passwords to remember.
flow: POST /auth/otp/request (purpose: login) to send/issue a code
POST /auth/otp/verify (purpose: login, CSRF token) to create session
Refresh session and redirect (default /account or previously intended page)

modes.title: Create your account
modes.copy: One number, one account — your requests, cylinders and claims together.
flow: Enter full name and phone number

authenticationAndAccess.sessionBootstrap: GET /auth/me on load to resolve the current user (id, phone, kind); logout via POST /auth/logout.
authenticationAndAccess.identityRule: One credential (phone) per account; existing numbers are directed to sign in rather than creating duplicates.
authenticationAndAccess.devNote: In non-production with dev OTP echo enabled, the issued code may be shown in the UI so testing works without real SMS.
authenticationAndAccess.guestAccess: Guests can submit a refill request and track it via a private tracking link/token without creating an account.

summaryForSharing: The customer page is a refill-order web app for Throne of Grace Integrated Ventures. Visitors can land on a branded home page, place an on-site or station cylinder refill order (with location for on-site), and track it via a private link. Customers can sign in/register with a phone OTP to see 'My requests', view live status/payment/refill details, cancel before acceptance, and explicitly link past guest requests. The experience is mobile-friendly, live-updating, and aligned to the current plan: the team refills the customer's cylinder on-site or at the station (no cylinder dispatched), with payment confirmed before completion. Policy pages are present as drafts pending professional review.
